request.idea: Ravi's shadow keeps running away from him.

bible.title: A Track for a Shadow
bible.narrativeComplexity: a few concrete moments a child can see
bible.userIdea: Ravi's shadow keeps running away from him.
bible.premise: ravi's shadow keeps running away, so he makes a chalk track that brings it back to his shoes.
bible.hook: Ravi stops, but his shadow races on.
bible.centralProblem: The shadow will not stay at Ravi's feet.
bible.stakes: Ravi cannot take a matching step.

locations.name: school yard
locations.visualIdentity: Sunny paving with plenty of space for chalk marks.

entities.name: Ravi's shadow
entities.identity: A dark silhouette with Ravi's short hair and hoodie shape, able to move independently.
entities.state: Tiptoeing beside Ravi around the loop.

entities.name: white chalk
entities.identity: A thick piece of chalk for drawing on paving.
entities.state: Held in Ravi's hand.

entities.name: chalk circle
entities.identity: A broad circle drawn around the runaway shadow.
entities.state: Contains Ravi instead of his shadow.

entities.name: chalk arrow
entities.identity: An arrow pointing into the empty chalk circle.
entities.state: Points from the shadow into the circle.

entities.name: chalk track
entities.identity: A trail of arrows ending in a small loop around Ravi's shoes.
entities.state: Leads from the circle into a small loop around Ravi's shoes.

expresses.shows: Plants both feet across the shadow's path.

beats.action: Ravi plants his feet. His shadow runs past his shoes.
beats.visualFocus: Ravi's orange hoodie, grey trousers, and short black hair contrast with the escaping shadow.
beats.compositionIntent: Separate the stationary child from the moving silhouette.
beats.pageTurnHook: The shadow leaves a gap behind Ravi.

entities.state: Running beyond Ravi's feet.

expresses.shows: Draws a chalk boundary around the moving silhouette.

beats.action: Ravi takes chalk from his pocket. He draws a circle around the shadow.
beats.visualFocus: The white circle surrounding dark feet.
beats.compositionIntent: Show Ravi completing a boundary around the shadow.
beats.textPurpose: Give Ravi a concrete first solution.

beats.compositionIntent: Put Ravi inside his own ineffective trap.
beats.textPurpose: Make the failed solution visibly mismatched.
